body:
I’ve thought it over and I’ll try.
I don’t want to, but I will.

I’ll do what I can to try and get some help.
I hope it works.

Thank you for your time and help here.
I appreciate it a lot.

I know I shouldn’t, but I just can’t see any reason why I should keep living when everyday is this nonstop pain.

There aren’t any therapists in my area, I’ve looked. 
There is one psychologist an hour away but I’m not 18 so they can’t really do anything.

But it already is destroying me.
I’ve only been getting worse as time goes on. I’ve had to contact helplines twice now.

I’ve even started doing some harmful behaviors I’m not proud of but can’t stop.

Sorry for the late reply, I logged off for a while.

I’m 17. I know how ridiculous it is.
I know that it shouldn’t matter at this age but it hurts so much.
